subject: Asset staging & press excerpt governance — Order Form publicity clause
messages:
From: Ava Malik <ava@pelorus.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 23:02:00 +0000
Subject: Quick: press mention & logo — case study excerpt + assets

Hey Vivek / Lauren,

Thanks again for the great trial run last quarter — Pelorus is putting together a short case study and we'd love to include a 1-2 sentence excerpt from Redwood and use your logo alongside our announcement. High level asks: at publication we want to (1) include a short quote/excerpt, (2) include Redwood's logo (vector preferred) and (3) coordinate an embargo window — target publish week of Dec 6.

We know these items usually need an Order Form / MSA publicity alignment, so wanted to surface early. Attached are our draft press snippet and the logo pack. Quick questions:
- Do you have any internal publicity carveouts we need to respect (e.g., product numbers, usage of metrics)?
- Who on your legal side should we send a redline to for the publicity clause?
- Any constraints on file formats or treatment of the logo? (we normally provide SVG + PNG)

Goal: have sign-off on excerpt and logo usage by Nov 26 so marketing can finalize layout. If the Order Form needs a small addendum we can accept a DocuSign flow — happy to turn quickly.

Attachments: pelorus-draft-quote.pdf (draft excerpt), pelorus_logo_v2.svg (vector), pelorus_logo_v2.png (raster)

Thanks — Ava
Ava Malik
Head of Marketing, Pelorus AI
ava@pelorus.io
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ava Malik <ava@pelorus.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick: press mention & logo — case study excerpt + assets

Ava — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the nice writeup. Quick read-through here and a few practical items from our side so we can move fast:

1) Publicity scope — we need the excerpt to be explicitly non-confidential (no internal metrics, customer-specific usage stats, or roadmap items). A 1-2 sentence customer quote + single-sentence headline blurb is fine.

2) Embargo & staging — Dec 6 publish window works; please confirm exact date once you lock it. We'll need final assets at least 72 hours prior (so by Dec 3) for signoff.

3) Logo treatment — Redwood requires use of official vector mark only, no color modification other than approved palette; we will provide the master files from our brand repo.

4) Contract/Order Form — our legal ops prefers a one-paragraph publicity addendum attached to the Order Form rather than amending the MSA itself for a single case study. I attached a quick redline to the Order Form language (redwood-orderform-redlines.docx) that:
   - Limits reference rights to marketing collateral and press related to this announcement only
   - Adds an embargo date field and a simple approval step for excerpt content
   - Preserves confidentiality carveouts for any redacted data

Could you loop in your legal contact to review the addendum? If they are okay with the redline we can send a DocuSign request and route internally for final sign-off.

Next steps:
- Pelorus legal to review redline (please send proposed edits)
- Once mutual language agreed, we'll push the DocuSign link and expect final signatures within 48 hours

I've CC'd Markus to help with brand assets and Lauren to track the Order Form flow.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Derek Chen <derek.chen@pelorus.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Malik <ava@pelorus.io>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick: press mention & logo — case study excerpt + assets

Vivek / Lauren — Derek here (Pelorus legal). Thanks for the redline, Vivek. We reviewed internally and propose three small edits:

1) Excerpt cap — please limit the public excerpt to maximum two sentences and remove any customer-identifying metrics (we'll redline language to this effect).
2) Logo usage — Pelorus requests we use vector (SVG) only; we can accept your vector on the condition that both parties maintain visual integrity (no color alterations) and that we both get to preview final layout.
3) Co-marketing credit — add a standard co-marketing attribution line (e.g., “in partnership with Redwood Inference”) under the design if space allows.

I attached Pelorus' proposed publicity redline (pelorus-proposed-publicity-redline.pdf) — mostly tightening the excerpt cap and adding a short layout preview requirement.

If you're cool with those three items we can sign via DocuSign. Also please confirm whether Redwood needs any additional data processing terms for marketing materials (we don't plan to include any PII).

Thanks,
Derek Chen
Senior Counsel, Pelorus AI
Attachment: pelorus-proposed-publicity-redline.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Derek Chen <derek.chen@pelorus.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick: press mention & logo — case study excerpt + assets

Derek — appreciate the clear redlines. All three points sound reasonable to us. Proposed final path:

• We accept the two-sentence cap and the no-metrics carveout.
• Logo: vector-only + no color modifications — agreed. Markus will provide the master SVG and a design handoff checklist.
• Co-marketing credit: happy to include a short “in partnership with Redwood Inference” line where layout permits.

Operationally:
1) I'll upload the finalized publicity addendum (publicity-addendum-v1.docx) to our shared Drive and start a DocuSign envelope to both Pelorus legal and the Pelorus signer (Ava). DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/fake-link/publicity-addendum
2) Please have Pelorus legal initial the two small inline edits in pelorus-proposed-publicity-redline.pdf and reply-all so we have a single redline thread.
3) Markus will share the SVG + a short brand checklist to the Drive link by EOD PST.

Timeline target: signatures in by 2026-11-24 EOD PDT so Pelorus marketing can finalize layout and we can meet the Dec 6 publication window. If anything blocks that timeline, flag immediately and we'll coordinate an interim statement.

Thanks — will kick off DocuSign and upload assets now.

—Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: publicity-addendum-v1.docx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/fake-link/pelorus-case-study-assets
